statnnet-methods.Rd

Methods for statnnet objects

Usage

# S3 method for class 'statnnet'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'statnnet'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'statnnet'
vcov(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'statnnet'
predict(object, newdata, ...)

# S3 method for class 'statnnet'
anova(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'statnnet'
summary(
  object,
  weights = FALSE,
  level = 0.95,
  effects = c("rowwise", "none", "partial"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x, object

A statnnet object.

...

Additional arguments passed to the underlying method where documented.

newdata

Optional data passed unchanged to the retained nnet fit.

weights

Include individual-weight Wald diagnostics in the summary.

level

Confidence level for individual-weight intervals and pointwise effect intervals. Curve intervals are not simultaneous confidence bands.

effects

Effect estimand to include. "rowwise" (the default) computes the average observed-row predictive finite difference by changing the focal predictor within each observed covariate row and then averaging. "partial" computes the average partial-dependence finite-difference contrast used by pce(), which additionally averages over the observed focal-predictor values. These estimands generally differ when the fitted response contains interactions. "none" omits effect summaries.

Examples

data("auto_mpg", package = "statnnet")
example_data <- auto_mpg
example_data$mpg <- as.numeric(scale(example_data$mpg))
example_data$weight <- as.numeric(scale(example_data$weight))
set.seed(3)
fit <- nnet::nnet(
  mpg ~ weight + origin,
  data = example_data,
  size = 1,
  linout = TRUE,
  decay = 0.1,
  Hess = TRUE,
  maxit = 500,
  trace = FALSE
)
model <- statnnet(fit, data = example_data, response = "continuous")

model
#> statnnet: statistical summary of a fitted nnet model
#> Formula: mpg ~ weight + origin
#> Architecture: 3-1-1; 6 weights; n = 392
#> Response: continuous; decay: 0.1
#> nnet convergence code: 0
#> Covariance: available (reciprocal condition number 0.000415)
summary(model, effects = "none")
#> statnnet summary
#> Formula: mpg ~ weight + origin
#> Response: continuous; architecture: 3-1-1
#> 
#> Effect summaries: omitted
#> 
#> Grouped input-to-hidden Wald summaries

#>  weight                    weight         1    0.9870157  41.431079
#>  origin originEurope, originJapan         2    1.9921566   3.804563
#>       p_value
#>  1.181581e-10
#>  1.482950e-01
anova(model)
